ZOHERY TOURS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

Customized private tours of DC

We have designed our Washington DC private tours around people like you. Based on our experience meeting the unique demands of our customers, we know that you want things done in a different way. You may have come to tour DC with family or a group of friends and enjoy doing fun things together.

If you have a schedule that would not allow you to book a bus tour at predetermined times, If you have a vision to catch a glimpse of a monument at sunrise or sunset either by yourself or with loved ones, The private tour is for you. It’s a personalized tour that is designed around your schedule and preferences. You can mix and match. Choose the landmarks and attractions you want to see, the time that you want the tour to start. The duration, and the language of the narration and we will do the very best to make it the most memorable tour you’ll ever take.

Our private tours take the concept of different one notch further by tailoring your touring experience to each and every of your particular needs. This is your designer tour. You design it and we take you there. Or follow our program and take it in your own pace and time.

Create your DC Private Tour or choose our other programs

  • Grand Tour of Washington
  • Washington After Dark

For our private tours, passengers pay for a minimum of 4 hours according to schedule below:

Passengers from 2 to 4 for the first 4 hours pay $400.00

*for each additional hour pay $100.00.


Passengers from 5 to 12 for the first 4 hours, pay $900.00

*for each additional hour $150.00.

Passengers from 13 to 19 for the first 4 hours, pay $1,200.00

*for each additional hour $175.00.


Passengers from 20 to 47 for the first 4 hours, pay $1,600.00

*for each additional person $50 and each additional hour $200.00.
